step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram illustrates Tata Global Beverages' hybrid cloud architecture on AWS. On the left, On-Prem connects via DirectConnect to Enterprise Applications hosted on EC2. At the top center, Users connect through Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) to Zscaler (EC2) and into Enterprise Applications (EC2). B2B incoming traffic flows through a Firewall (EC2) to AWS WAF, and then to SAP applications on EC2. On the right, GuardDuty monitors the environment, triggering a Lambda function that sends alert notifications to mobile devices.
